# Chapter 10 finite ART-19 contract

## Ownership and limits

- Layer A: `chapter10_semantics.py` owns the fixed synthetic source graph, parent IDs/time/scope, candidate/ownership/verification distinctions, approval denials, complete Case rows and bounded input inventory. `check_chapter10_contract.py` selects the four complete canonical documents and associates shared typed fields with chapter headings and visible owners. `chapter10_regressions.py` owns finite counterexamples.
- Layer B: existing `publication_projection.py` 1.1.0 and its exact pinned renderer remain the only Markdown/Kramdown/HTML/URL projection owner. No chapter parser, syntax regex or generic renderer fixture is added. Heading/field ownership is Layer A selection, not re-parsing Markdown.
- Layer C: existing Content Safety Policy 1.2.0 scans JSON strings and all projected reader fields/absolute destinations. No grammar or dependency changes.
- This is not a generic OSINT product, network collector, source-authenticity verifier, PII recognizer or legal-authorization engine. Fixed authored source content has an exact per-source digest baseline; rehashing new content does not make it an accepted source. Unknown field shape and declared personal/credential material are rejected. Arbitrary real information is not guaranteed to be recognized semantically.
- Two public JSON files are assembled as `{register, bundle}` for the single closed JSON Schema. The schema is committed, not inferred from runtime input. Only the repository's existing finite schema keyword subset is supported; unsupported keywords fail closed.
- Hash scope is the UTF-8 bytes of one identified bundle `content` string without normalization, not the enclosing file or source authenticity. Publication QA separately compares whole download bytes.
- Original collection class and the actual learner action are separate. All three original classes appear as authored assumptions; the learner only reads/compares supplied data and writes a bounded summary, with zero network/authentication/rate-test actions.
- ROE-2026-009 v1 remains Draft with expired parent authority and three unchanged Objects. Owner confirmation and a parent Asset reference never add a RoE Object or authorize an action. Handoffs remain planned, not delivered; Chapter11 remains independent.

## Finite regression families

| Prefix | Evidence obligation |
|---|---|
| CH10-POS | All five verification states and three original classes; conservative CT/package withholding, smaller budgets and bounded analysis remain accepted |
| CH10-SHAPE | Every required key, unknown properties in every object, strict scalar types and finite inventories |
| CH10-SEM | Parent/window/scope preservation; class/action mismatch; source/hash/time/terms/data; independent origins; name-only merge; confidence/evidence; historical DNS; third party; dependency; authorization; Gap/Owner/time; coverage/Handoff |
| CH10-BUNDLE | Source inventory, declared non-acquisition, content substitution and rehashing do not authorize adoption or personal-data aggregation |
| CH10-HANDOFF | An owner-confirmed candidate downgraded to Unknown cannot remain in the confirmed-candidate handoff |
| CH10-JSON / TIME / SCHEMA | Duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, malformed UTF-8/JSON/time, unsupported schema vocabulary |
| CH10-DOC / EX / DIAG | Canonical zero findings; finite semantic field presence; exception mutation/movement/duplication/removal and exact actionable cardinality diagnostics |
| CH10-SURFACE / ORDER | Direct unsafe preamble/body/tail; unexpected chapter section; one shared unsupported marker; every exercise explanation precedes the command |
| CH10-SOURCE | Every required Source ID must match the existing repository token vocabulary independently in body and references; lowercase-suffix source mutations, uppercase/digit/underscore/prefix field mutations and exact-ID punctuation counterparts |
| CH10-PARITY | Every scalar/empty-array row from both JSON files is checked against shared projected Case fields |
| CH10-IO / REPO | Fixed regular paths, symlink/ancestor/platform/size/special-file refusal; root script/route/source/index obligations; publication preflight must precede generation |

The root command runs every finite regression and is repeated under PYTHONHASHSEED 0/1/7/42 in release verification. Direct publication-before-delete negative probes are additionally run through the actual root `sync:docs` command in an owned clean worktree. Regression counts do not represent independent human reviews or general grammar coverage.

PR130 review thread `PRRT_kwDOTi9cus6iB-DN` / discussion `4003243071` maps to `CH10-SOURCE-3-both-rendered-suffix` (historical `SRC-CT-001x`) and the complete `CH10-SOURCE` family. The production consumer reuses `SOURCE_ID_RE` from the existing import-safe representative gate; it does not call that gate's legacy rendering helpers, redefine the ID grammar or parse Markdown. The six fixed Source IDs are compared as extracted identities, not substring occurrences. The punctuation counterparts isolate Source ownership; they do not waive the separately required exact semantic/provenance fields.

## Exact, non-expandable provenance

`publication-contract.json` fixes each full typed field, heading path, visible link owner and required cardinality of one. No domain-wide, paragraph-prefix or whole-document waivers exist. New or moved text does not inherit an exemption.

The 36 individually inspected canonical fields comprise:

- Five analytic fields: manuscript's narrower offline plan, exercise prerequisites, impact/stop/cleanup explanation; Template's zero-action budget row; Case's explicit limitations on real-environment/legal/PII assurance. Each describes prohibition, absence or a limit, not instructions for prohibited operations.
- Thirty-one host-scanner fields: eighteen exact primary/delegation/build-document citation destinations; bounded version/section/filename references including `security.txt`; two reserved-name references adjacent to Japanese prose. These are not assessment targets. Exact owners and cardinality remain mandatory.

The generic scanner remains conservative; these chapter-specific reference/analytic meanings are reviewed at their complete field and section scope. Every exception has changed/moved/duplicate/missing negative tests. A shared Policy defect is not implemented here.

## Bounded existing-chapter compatibility

- Chapter7/8/9 invocation inventories add Chapter10 immediately before site generation. Chapter8's literal publishing-guide marker adds the same chapter. The invariant and all earlier preflights remain intact.
- Chapter10 uses the previously reserved chapter order 53, between Chapter9 (52) and Chapter11 (54). Existing chapter order/semantics/prose are unchanged. Additional-page order 260 was already owned by Chapter17, so the new Case/Source use unused orders 261/262 rather than changing that owner.
- Berkeley/WSTG actual scoped audit dates and Chapter10 mappings advance; existing version/status/historical notes remain byte-identical. New RFC sources are restricted to the adopted claims and dated errata status. Registry-wide checkedAt is unchanged.
- Parent canonical files, shared projection/policy, formatter revision and dependency locks remain unchanged. No raw predraft/ZIP or generated site/cache is tracked.
